item.title: Decision Paralysis: When Freedom Becomes a Curse
item.description: Two hosts unpack a Norwegian article where a professor calls decision avoidance a public health problem. The paradox of choice, the psychological immune system, pre-mortems, and why sitting still in the boat is not a neutral position.

item.title: LetterTranscriber: reading 1930s handwriting with AI (preview)
item.description: A two-minute preview: how a Flask app turns scanned Norwegian letters from the 1920s and 30s into corrected, annotated transcripts using Gemini.
